modules.title: Foundations
modules.description: What agents are, where they came from, the LLM engine inside them, and the loop that makes them act.

modules.title: Core Building Blocks
modules.description: Prompts, tools, reasoning, memory, retrieval and context — the components every agent is assembled from.

modules.title: Architectures & Patterns
modules.description: Proven workflow patterns, single- and multi-agent architectures, human oversight, and the protocols that connect agents to the world.

modules.title: Agents in the Wild
modules.description: How real agent categories work: coding, computer-use, deep research, conversational and voice, and embodied agents in the physical world.

modules.title: Building Agents
modules.description: Write an agent from scratch, learn the frameworks and SDKs professionals use, and run agents on open-weight models you host yourself.

modules.title: Production Engineering
modules.description: Evaluate, observe, harden, optimize and operate agents in the real world.

modules.title: Safety & Security
modules.description: Prompt injection, sandboxing, permissions, guardrails, alignment and governance for autonomous systems.

modules.title: Advanced & Frontier
modules.description: How agentic models are trained, how agents improve themselves, and the open problems that define the field's future.

paths.title: Curious Newcomer
paths.description: No coding required. Understand what agents are, how they work, what they can and can't do, and why it matters.

paths.title: Agent Builder
paths.description: For developers shipping agents. From the first tool call to a production-grade, evaluated, secured system.

paths.title: Researcher
paths.description: The science: reasoning, planning, architectures, benchmarks, training with RL, self-improvement and alignment.

paths.title: Product & Business Leader
paths.description: Decide where agents create value, how to scope them, what they cost, and how to manage the risks.
